Self-directed higher education

“Explore. Challenge. Curate. Wisdom. Scholarship. Recognition.”

Explore your worlds through higher education; challenge yourself, peers, and influences to high standards; aggregate and curate useful material for fast, searchable access; pursue scholarship; and seek recognition through authentic credentials and materials.

The organization also describes free, fast access to educational materials and publications and the use of rosters to add momentum to research efforts.

Twenty-two major manifestations

01 / Ezekiel 1:4–28

The Throne-Chariot / Kavod of YHWH

Storm wind, enormous cloud, fire flashing within fire, radiant beings, intersecting wheels, crystalline expanse, a sapphire-like throne, and above it a human-like appearance surrounded by fire and radiance.

02 / Ezekiel 8:1–4

The Fiery Human-Like Appearance

A close manifestation described with the appearance of a man, fire below and brilliant radiance above, immediately associated with the glory of the Elohim of Israel.

03 / Ezekiel 10

The Glory, Cherubim and Living Wheels

The glory of YHWH amid cherubim, living wheels, fire, cloud, and the overwhelming architecture of the throne vision.

04 / Ezekiel 43:1–5

The Glory Returns to the Temple

The glory of the Elohim of Israel approaches from the east; its sound is like many waters, the earth shines, and the divine presence fills the Temple.

05 / Isaiah 6:1–7

YHWH Enthroned Above the Temple

YHWH seated upon a high and exalted throne, the train filling the Temple, immense seraphim overhead, foundations shaking, and smoke filling the sanctuary.

06 / Habakkuk 3:3–15

YHWH as Cosmic Divine Warrior

Divine radiance fills the heavens; mountains writhe, the deep roars, sun and moon halt, and YHWH advances through earth and sea.

07 / Zechariah 14:3–7

YHWH Descends Upon the Mount of Olives

YHWH goes forth to battle; His feet stand upon the Mount of Olives and the mountain splits in two, opening an immense valley.

08 / 2 Samuel 22:8–16

YHWH Descending in Storm and Fire

Earth shakes, smoke rises, consuming fire erupts, heavens bend downward, YHWH rides upon a cherub, darkness surrounds Him, and lightning exposes the depths.

09 / Psalm 29

The Voice of YHWH Over the Waters

The voice of YHWH thunders over immense waters, shatters cedars, makes mountains leap, flashes flames of fire, and convulses wilderness.

10 / Psalm 68:8–18

Sinai Trembles Before Elohim

Earth shakes, heavens pour forth, Sinai trembles, and Elohim advances with myriads upon myriads of divine chariots.

11 / Psalm 97:1–7

Fire Before YHWH

Cloud and thick darkness surround Him; fire proceeds before Him, lightning illuminates the world, earth trembles, and mountains melt like wax.

12 / Job 38:1–41:34

YHWH Answers From the Whirlwind

YHWH manifests through the storm and unveils creation at cosmic scale: earth, seas, gates of death, constellations, lightning, Behemoth, and Leviathan.

13 / 2 Chronicles 7:1–3

Fire From Heaven and Temple Glory

Fire descends from heaven and consumes the sacrifice; the glory of YHWH fills the Temple so completely that the priests cannot enter.

14 / Deuteronomy 33:2, 26–29

YHWH Coming From Sinai

YHWH comes from Sinai, shines forth with fiery majesty, and rides the heavens in divine splendor.

15 / Prophet Wars

Wrath From Heaven Collage

Pillar of fire and cloud, Korah's rebellion, Deborah versus Sisera, Elijah at Carmel, fire from heaven, Elisha at Dothan, and Isaiah versus Assyria, unified around the central fire-strike.
